title: Off Broadway Lounge – July 6th, 2013
author: madwire
excerpt: Tonight was one of our most busy nights down at the Off Broadway Lounge. UFC fight night brought in everyone, and good music kept them there. As the night kept on, only our regulars remained. I’m excited to see everyone again in 2 weeks! DJ Dillon
